# Spendly

> SaaS platform for restaurants to monitor ingredient prices from KSeF supplier invoices.

Spendly helps restaurant owners track price changes across their supply chain by importing invoices from the Polish KSeF tax invoice system. It highlights price increases before they hit food cost margins.

## Product

- Automatic price tracking per ingredient and supplier
- Food cost trend charts and monthly spend analytics
- Price change alerts with configurable thresholds
- KSeF invoice sync and manual invoice import
- OCR invoice scanning from photo or PDF (15-second processing)
- Supplier management with invoice history

## Public URLs

- [Homepage](https://www.spendly.pl/): main landing page explaining the full product, how it works, features, and social proof
- [KSeF integration](https://www.spendly.pl/ksef): how Spendly connects to Poland's national e-invoice system (KSeF) to automatically import purchase invoices for a restaurant's NIP number without manual file uploads
- [Food cost control](https://www.spendly.pl/food-cost): automatic food cost calculation based on imported invoices, real-time supplier price monitoring, and alerts when costs approach profitability thresholds
- [OCR invoices](https://www.spendly.pl/ocr-faktur): AI-powered invoice reading from a phone photo or PDF in ~15 seconds; captures supplier, product lines, prices, quantities, VAT rates, and dates automatically
- [Price comparison](https://www.spendly.pl/porownanie-cen): anonymous benchmark comparing a restaurant's own purchase prices to the median price other restaurants pay for the same product, computed only once at least 5 restaurants buy that product (k-anonymity, no individual restaurant's price is ever exposed)
- [Who it's for](https://www.spendly.pl/dla-kogo): overview of restaurant industry segments Spendly serves (restaurants, pizzerias, cafes, bars, hotels, catering, food trucks, canteens, ghost kitchens, chains) with food-cost specifics per segment
- [Blog](https://www.spendly.pl/blog): 30+ Polish-language guides on food cost, KSeF, pricing, staff costs, and restaurant profitability
- [Pricing](https://www.spendly.pl/cennik): Start plan free forever (1 location, unlimited KSeF invoices, 50 OCR receipts/month); Pro plan 150 PLN/month (up to 3 locations, unlimited OCR, supplier comparison, food cost, AI assistant), 30-day free Pro trial with no credit card required; custom quote for multi-location chains

## Key guides (Polish)

- [Jak obliczyć food cost](https://www.spendly.pl/blog/jak-liczyc-food-cost): food cost formula for a single dish and for a whole restaurant, worked burger example, net vs gross (VAT 8% food, 23% drinks), yield and waste, theoretical vs actual food cost
- [Ile powinien wynosić food cost](https://www.spendly.pl/blog/ile-powinien-wynosic-food-cost): target food cost ranges by restaurant type and how to derive your own target from fixed costs and labor
- [Czym jest beverage cost](https://www.spendly.pl/blog/beverage-cost-restauracja): beverage cost formula and norms for beer, wine and spirits, cost of a single drink, wine-by-the-glass losses
- [Marża a narzut w gastronomii](https://www.spendly.pl/blog/marza-a-narzut-gastronomia): margin vs markup, formulas and conversion
- [Prime cost](https://www.spendly.pl/blog/prime-cost-restauracja): food + beverage + labor cost as share of revenue
- [KSeF dla restauracji](https://www.spendly.pl/blog/ksef-dla-restauracji-od-kiedy-obowiazkowy): Poland's mandatory e-invoicing (KSeF) deadlines for restaurants in 2026–2027

## Free calculators (Polish, no sign-up)

- [Kalkulator food cost](https://www.spendly.pl/kalkulatory/kalkulator-food-cost): dish food cost from ingredient cost and menu price, plus price for a target food cost
- [Kalkulator marży i narzutu](https://www.spendly.pl/kalkulatory/kalkulator-marzy-i-narzutu): margin and markup conversion for menu pricing
- [Kalkulator beverage cost](https://www.spendly.pl/kalkulatory/kalkulator-beverage-cost): cost per drink or pour
- [Kalkulator progu rentowności](https://www.spendly.pl/kalkulatory/kalkulator-progu-rentownosci): restaurant break-even revenue

## Out of scope

- [Sign in](https://www.spendly.pl/sign-in): authentication page, no useful content for AI retrieval
- [Sign up](https://www.spendly.pl/sign-up): registration page, no useful content for AI retrieval
- All authenticated app routes (/dashboard, /suppliers, /products, /invoices, /price-alerts, /reports, /predictive, /pending-invoices, /ai-cfo, /settings/ksef, /settings/cost-centers, /admin/users) require login and contain tenant-specific data
